tenancy.title: Multi-tenancy
tenancy.subtitle: Opt-in, default off. With the flag off nothing is registered and no query changes.
tenancy.bannerDisabled: Tenancy is off. No global scope is registered, no creating hook is attached, and every query below compiles exactly as it did before this feature existed.
tenancy.bannerEnabled: Tenancy is on. Listed models are scoped to the current team and rows with no tenant are hidden.
tenancy.nullRowsStrict: strict — rows with no tenant are hidden
tenancy.nullRowsShared: shared — rows with no tenant are visible to every tenant
tenancy.modelsDescription: A model is scoped only when the flag is on AND the class is listed in myra.tenancy.models.
tenancy.modelsEmpty: No models are listed for tenant scoping.
tenancy.honestTitle: What this page is not claiming
tenancy.honestBody: While the flag is off every model reports "Scope registered: No". That is the point: the disabled path registers nothing, so the compiled SQL is unchanged. The proof is a committed baseline captured before any tenancy code existed.
tenancy.auditBody: Run the audit. It refuses readiness while any row still has a null tenant, because those rows would disappear for everyone but a super-admin.
tenancy.failClosedBody: When scoping is active and no tenant resolves, the predicate becomes 1 = 0. No tenant means no rows, never all rows.

demo.title: Reports & server-side aggregation
demo.description: Every number on this page is computed by the database. Nothing but the buckets reaches the browser.
demo.period: Change the period. The window is half-open, so the previous period is contiguous with no off-by-one.
demo.bucket: Switch granularity. The bucket expression is the only place a date becomes SQL.
demo.compare: Turn on a comparison. Two disjoint window scans aligned by ordinal — never one conditional aggregate spanning both.
demo.dimension: Switch the grouping axis: a date, a plain column, or a relation.
demo.truncated: A categorical dimension is capped by limit(). The tail folds into one SQL-computed Other row, and non-additive measures show an em dash rather than a fabricated number.
demo.measures: Toggle measures. Undeclared names are dropped rather than rejected, so there is no field-enumeration oracle.
demo.views: Save the current state. Report views reuse the table_views table with a report: prefix — zero new tables.
demo.export: Export the buckets, not the source rows. The result set is already capped.
